risk_note: RV2 by path (platform config, union wiring). Real JD adapter wiring (D10-498, D10-500), the same shape as B1-04k: JD_APP_KEY and JD_APP_SECRET_FILE in credential-env, refused in local and test, file source refused in prod, secret read once at startup, no value or path in errors or logs. createUnionRegistry assembles the real adapter only when jdLive is passed, so existing behaviour is unchanged; the JD endpoint config stays demo. Both variables unset on staging keeps jd unimplemented without a warning, as frozen [AC-B1-04k#17] and D10-479 require. JD_SITE_ID is an optional non-secret AppConfig value for B1-04zd. product_key.jd.mode is read per app, defaults to item when unset, and a read failure raises instead of falling back to item, so sku-mode orders cannot get wrong keys.
